tool.title: Edit a skill
tool.description: Change one existing local skill's instruction file through a gate: it must resolve as skill-fetch serves it, be tracked in the working repository, not be generated, be granted `skill-update` to the actor by a policy, be unchanged since it was read, keep its name and parse, and add only links that resolve. A gate that cannot decide refuses. Writes the working tree; the caller commits.

inputs.name: new_content
inputs.description: The whole new file: front matter and body.

inputs.name: base_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 hex of the file as the caller read it.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.description: The declared actor making the write; a policy must grant it skill-update.

inputs.name: process
inputs.description: The BPMN process the write is a step of, for the PROV-O activity.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.description: Written or not, every gate's verdict with its reason, findings, and the PROV-O activity of an accepted write when a step was named.

outputs.name: activity
outputs.description: The PROV-O activity of an accepted write that named its process, task and role; absent otherwise. Pass it to workflow_complete's `activities` for that step.

$comment.comment:
folio-assistant#875: a skill edit goes through a governed Tool node, not a
raw file write. The spec is the spec-kit comment on #875, Adjudicated by
the owner 2026-10-29. Implemented in the tools layer (https://github.com/litlfred/cat-harness-tools).
